lines.zh: 岩石碎裂声中传来低沉的呼啸。
沉重的脚步声回响在洞穴中。
lines.en: Heavy footsteps echo in the cave.

lines.zh: 粗糙的皮肤摩擦发出吱吱声。
身体扭动，发出轻微摩擦声。
lines.en: Body twists, making soft scraping sounds.
I drag myself through the cracks in the stone.

lines.zh: 沿着矿道的回音缓缓移动。
lines.en: I move slowly along the echo of the mine shaft.

lines.zh: 静静地注视着洞穴深处。
lines.en: Staring into the depths of the cave.

lines.zh: 凝视着黑暗，似乎在思考。
lines.en: Staring into the dark, as if thinking.

lines.zh: 静静地等待着，耐心十足。
蜷缩成一团，似乎在积蓄力量。
lines.en: Cowering into a ball, gathering strength.

lines.zh: 静静地观察着四周环境。
静静地潜伏着，准备出击。

lines.en: Ear pressed to the cave wall, I listen.

lines.zh: 静静地埋伏在洞穴深处。
lines.en: Lurking silently in the cave depths.
I cling to the rock wall and wait for the days to pass.

lines.zh: 数着钟乳石滴水的声响。
lines.en: I count the drip of the stalactites.

lines.zh: 在洞穴最深处屏住呼吸。
lines.en: I hold my breath in the deepest part of the cave.

lines.zh: 把身形收进岩层的褶皱。
lines.en: I fold my body into the seams of the stone.

lines.zh: 视线转向玩家，露出獠牙。
lines.en: Eyes turn to the player, showing fangs.

lines.zh: 目光紧盯着玩家的身影。
lines.en: Gaze fixed on the player's silhouette.

lines.zh: 突然向玩家投去怨恨的目光。
lines.en: Suddenly glares at the player with hatred.

lines.zh: 盯紧玩家，眼神闪烁不定。
lines.en: Locks on the player, eyes flickering.

lines.zh: 目光锁定，随时准备攻击。
火把的光先落进我眼里。
lines.en: Your torchlight reaches my eyes first.

lines.zh: 听见你的镐声，我抬起头。
lines.en: I lift my head at the sound of your pickaxe.

lines.zh: 你离地面越远，我看得越清。
lines.en: The deeper you go, the clearer I see you.

lines.zh: 一直望着你来的那条矿道。
lines.en: I keep watching the shaft you came down.

lines.zh: 在你看不见的岩顶注视你。
lines.en: I watch from the ceiling you never check.
The deeper you go, the clearer I see you.

lines.zh: 我从黑暗里辨出你的轮廓。
lines.en: I pick your outline out of the dark.

lines.zh: 这块岩壁后面，我在看你。
lines.en: I am behind this wall, watching you.

lines.zh: 你抬头时我已缩回阴影。
lines.en: By the time you look up, I am back in shadow.

lines.zh: 视线的重量压在你后颈。
lines.en: The weight of my stare sits on your neck.
Ow, why are you biting me!

lines.zh: 你手中的光芒引来了我的注意。
地面下的生物感受到了你的热量。
你身上食物的气息让我心动。
lines.en: The scent of your food tempts me.

lines.zh: 深入黑暗，你离我更近了。
lines.en: Venture deeper, and you draw closer.

lines.zh: 光亮之下，我的猎物显露。
lines.en: In the light, my prey is revealed.

lines.zh: 阴影中的异变，即将吞噬你。
lines.en: The anomaly in the shadows will consume you.

lines.zh: 你身上的金属吸引着我。
lines.en: The metal on you draws me.

lines.zh: 黑暗中寻找着猎物的气息。
lines.en: I seek the scent of prey in the dark.

lines.zh: 你身上的血肉让我蠢蠢欲动。
探索者，你离我的领地太近了。
lines.en: Explorer, you've come too close to my domain.

lines.zh: 碰撞触发了我们的战斗。
你的身体干扰了我的路径。
lines.en: Your body interferes with my path.

lines.zh: 你无意间触发了我的攻击。

lines.en: Coexist with me and create wonders.

lines.zh: 我们可以在黑暗中找到彼此。
lines.en: We can find each other in the darkness.

lines.zh: 与我一起，感受更深的黑暗。
与我结合，探索更深的洞穴。
lines.en: Merge with me and explore deeper caves.
Combine with me and evolve together.

lines.zh: 与我共生，体验更深的恐惧。
lines.en: Coexist with me and experience deeper fear.

lines.zh: 我感觉有东西盯上了我。
lines.en: I feel something is watching me.

lines.zh: 洞穴深处传来一声尖叫。
lines.en: A scream echoes from the depths.

lines.zh: 我体内涌动着不祥的光芒。
lines.en: An ominous glow pulses within me.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸让我更加饥饿。
你身上的血味如此诱人。
lines.en: The scent of your blood is tantalizing.
Only death can set you free.
I searched these caves a long time for you.
You don't know who I am.
I've searched many nights for you.

lines.zh: 你只是我晚餐的一部分。
lines.en: You're just part of my meal.
This cave is just you and me.
The taste is almost within reach.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的火把走了三条道。
lines.en: I followed your torch down three tunnels.
This cave is my hunting ground.

lines.zh: 矿道尽头只剩下你一个。
lines.en: Only you are left at the end of the tunnel.

lines.zh: 深入地下的人归我所有。
lines.en: Those who go deep belong to me.
The deeper you dig, the closer I get.
This layer of rock does not separate us.

lines.zh: 我记住了你火把的味道。
lines.en: I remember the smell of your torch.
The deep has handed you to me.
The prey is in dire straits.
You will never be seen again.
The rock is closing in on you.
I tighten my grip from below.

lines.zh: 你会听见头顶的碎裂声。
lines.en: You will hear cracking above your head.
Your light will not last long.
I grow as the cave grows.
This path leads only into my mouth.
My fingers come out of the fissure.
I have walled off your way back.
The air and the patience are both mine.
You are already standing in my stomach.
Stone spikes burst up under your feet!
I come down wrapped in falling rubble!
Long claws reach out of the crack!
I dig straight through your armor!
I press your torch into the stone!
One bite shatters your lantern glass!

lines.zh: 第十天的夜里，岩层裂开。
lines.en: On the tenth night, the rock splits.

lines.zh: 洞穴深处响起第一声低语。
lines.en: The first whisper sounds deep in the cave.

lines.zh: 你的火把照亮了我的一角。
lines.en: Your torch lights one corner of me.
A new shadow joins the cave wall.
I wake with the ore vein.

lines.zh: 地底的时间终于够长了。
lines.en: The time underground is finally long enough.
A stalactite falls, and I come out.

lines.zh: 从你脚下的石层里渗出。
lines.en: I seep out of the stone beneath you.
The cave has learned to breathe.
